A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

The main takeaway from our work is that
the superpotential and the D-term potential for D-branes on N = 1 flux backgrounds are related to the BPS domain walls in four dimensions and the cosmic strings respectively.

the D-terms of space-time filling Dp-branes on general four-dimensional N=1 backgrounds can be written in a very simple form, as a sum of a D-term for each harmonic form of the background, which is the same as the corresponding BPS string tension.
